The '''Parmic system''' was found in the [[Parmic sector/Legends|Parmic sector]].

==History==
[[File:Ta_beam_load.jpg|thumb|left|180px|[[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin|Zaarin]] watching the installation of the [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] weapon on a [[TIE/ad starfighter|TIE Avenger]].]]

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Parmic system contained a research facility operated by [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]]. It was here that Zaarin equipped his [[TIE series/Legends|TIE]] squadrons with a new [[Tractor beam/Legends|beam weapon]] in the time following the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].

The system was also the site of the [[Arms Race]].
